responsibility: Provides rustc’s typed-index collection infrastructure: `lib.rs` serves as the crate root that assembles the indexed-collection APIs, re-exports the core typed-index traits, slices, vectors, and `newtype_index!` macro, gates nightly-only interval support, and defines the crate-wide static size assertion macro; `vec` (`vec.rs`) supplies `IndexVec` and related typed-index vector functionality so compiler data can be stored, grown, resized, iterated, and converted while remaining keyed by `Idx` newtypes; `bit_set` (`bit_set.rs`) provides the indexed-domain membership structures, including dense, hybrid, chunked, sparse, and finite bit sets plus row-oriented bit matrices and the associated set operations, iteration, search, and representation-adaptive behavior for efficient compiler analyses; and `interval` (`interval.rs`) provides normalized interval-based indexed sets and sparse row matrices for cases where membership clusters into contiguous runs. Together, the crate gives the compiler its foundational, type-safe indexing abstractions and efficient indexed collection implementations for vectors, sets, and matrices used throughout rustc.
